svg.text: Gatehouse with clock and mortarboard vane; one wing per college; the quad in front. Hires come out of the gate.
States, and more colleges than wings
Two wings each side at most; the fifth and later share an annex. Counts and states sit on the sign.
Wing states (from the Hosts filter's hosts)
Installed and logged in on a shown host
Warm lit windows, open door, pennant up
Dark windows, shut door, small key plaque
Scaffolding and dust sheet, pennant furled
Probe failed, Windows, or not read yet
Normal art, daylight glass; never drawn as missing
